title: Evolution of Local Government in Nigeria

events.title: Pre-1976 System
events.text: Native Authorities, District Councils, No uniformity, Weak funding

events.title: 1976 Reform
events.text: Uniform single-tier, Third tier of government, Statutory funding, State Ministry supervision

events.title: 1989 Reform
events.text: Presidential system, Separation of powers, Direct funding, Ministry abolished
